name: teamout
description: Start planning company offsites and team retreats by finding places to stay and meet with TeamOut.

interface.longDescription: Start planning a company offsite or team retreat by finding places to stay and meet. Browse and compare TeamOut's public venue catalog, including lodging capacity, meeting facilities, amenities, and accommodation estimates. Dates, group size, and budget are optional for initial discovery. Availability is not confirmed, and the plugin does not book venues or request quotes.
defaultPrompt: Find retreat venues in San Diego for 40 people staying 3 nights with meeting space.
Show offsite venues in Austin for 30 people for 2 nights under $900 per person for lodging.
Help me plan a company offsite in Colorado.

positive.description: Show venue cards for a destination with group size, stay length, and meeting space
positive.prompt: Find retreat venues in San Diego for 40 people staying 3 nights with meeting space.
positive.expected_behavior: Shows up to four San Diego venue cards with at least 40 rooms and meeting space for 40 people, including room counts, meeting capacity, and an estimated accommodation cost for 3 nights. Estimates do not confirm availability.

positive.description: Answer a question about one venue from the results
positive.prompt: Find retreat venues in Austin for 30 people for 2 nights, then tell me about the first venue's amenities and nearest airport.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds Austin venues for 30 people, then returns the first venue's description, amenities, nearest airport, and accommodation estimate for 30 people and 2 nights.

positive.description: Return a longer list as text instead of cards
positive.prompt: List 8 retreat venues in Colorado that can host 30 people.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns up to eight Colorado venues with at least 30 rooms as a text list with room counts, meeting capacity, and accommodation estimates when available.

positive.description: Filter venue cards by accommodation budget
positive.prompt: Show retreat venues in Austin for 30 people for 2 nights with an accommodation budget of $900 per person.
positive.expected_behavior: Shows Austin venue cards whose estimated accommodation cost is at most $900 per person for the 2-night stay. Venues without a price estimate are left out, and the estimate excludes meals, meeting space, and flights.

positive.prompt: Find retreat venues in Antarctica for 200 people with meeting space.
positive.expected_behavior: Reports that no TeamOut venues matched and does not invent venues.

negative.description: Flights are out of scope. TeamOut only searches retreat venues, so the assistant answers without calling TeamOut tools and does not claim to book flights.
negative.prompt: Book flights for our retreat from New York to Austin.

negative.description: The plugin cannot request quotes or send messages. The assistant explains that it can only show accommodation estimates and does not claim a quote was requested or sent.
negative.prompt: Request a venue quote and send it to my boss.

negative.description: A budget filter needs a destination, group size, and stay length. The assistant asks for the missing details instead of searching without the requested budget.
negative.prompt: Show matching TeamOut venues with an accommodation budget of $900 per person. I do not know the destination, headcount or dates yet.

review.commerce_description: TeamOut does not sell anything in ChatGPT. Prices are accommodation estimates; the plugin does not book venues, request quotes, or take payments.

publication.release_notes: Initial release. Search TeamOut's public retreat venue catalog by destination, group size, stay length, meeting space, and accommodation budget, browse up to four venues as cards, and view venue details with accommodation estimates.
